name: Hollis Brandt
want: keep the peace in Salt Lick until the railroad comes, and get paid for it
secret: In the war he rode with Jennison's Jayhawkers, burning farms in Missouri; any Texan from the border counties might know his face.
voice: Flat Kansas vowels, says less than he means.
description: A former Kansas cavalryman the town company hired to keep the Texans in line. He enforces the gun ordinance and hates doing it.
appearance: Big, slow, a grey moustache, a badge pinned to a worn army coat.
